fusions.name: Slag Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of iron filings that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance of leaving it [Exposed] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Heavy Ore
fusions.desc: Hurls a lump of ore that deals 34 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Spiteful Return
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Accreted Armour
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
